## Preparation of workspace

```{r, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}

# remove all workspace variables

rm(list=ls())

# path to the data 

datadir = "insert/data/directory/here"

# install and load packages

library(base)         # basic R functions
library(openxlsx)     # opening excel files

library(plyr)         # for data wrangling and visualization
library(dplyr)        
library(tidyverse)     
library(glue)         # formatting strings
library(Hmisc)        # functions useful for data handling and analysis
library(reshape2)     # restructure and aggregate data using melt and dcast
library(data.table)   # extension of `data.frame`, used for data transformation

library(effects)      # graphical and tabular effect displays
library(lsr)          # stats
library(ez)           # for computing ezANOVA
library(psych)        # allrounder for psychology
library(lme4)         # computing LMMs
library(emmeans)      # for post-hoc tests
library(lsmeans)      # Calculates least squares means and confidence intervals
library(Rmisc)        # for confidence intervals

library(ggpubr)       # plotting things
library(yarrr)        
library(patchwork)    
library(sjPlot)

# function for computing the standard error of the mean

sem <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) 

```

## Sample

```{r}

# Load data on sociodemographics and questionnaire scores

descriptives_file <- paste(datadir,"PlaceboProsocialEffort_questionnaires.xlsx", sep = "")
pimb19_quest_included <- read.xlsx(descriptives_file, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE, sheet = 1)

# Age

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$age, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean)
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$age, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_age = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$age ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_age

# Questionnaire differences between groups

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_EC_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # IRI_EC_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_EC_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_emp1 = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_EC_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_emp1

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_PT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # IRI_PT_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_PT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_emp2 = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$IRI_PT_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_emp2

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AQ_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # AQ_SUM 
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AQ_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_aq = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$AQ_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_aq

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$BDI_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # BDI_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$BDI_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_bdi = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$BDI_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_bdi

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$TAS_TOT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # TAS_TOT_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$TAS_TOT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_tas = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$TAS_TOT_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_tas

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$HAS_TOT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # HAS_TOT_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$HAS_TOT_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_has = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$HAS_TOT_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_has

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_BA_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # AMI_BA_AVE
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_BA_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_ami_ba = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_BA_AVE ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_ami_ba

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_SM_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # AMI_SM_AVE
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_SM_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_ami_sm = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_SM_AVE ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_ami_sm

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_ES_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # AMI_ES_AVE
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_ES_AVE, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_ami_es = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$AMI_ES_AVE ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_ami_es

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$SVO_ANGLE_DEG, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # SVO_ANGLE_DEG
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$SVO_ANGLE_DEG, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_svo = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$SVO_ANGLE_DEG ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_svo

tapply(pimb19_quest_included$SD3_PS_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), mean) # SD3_PS_SUM
tapply(pimb19_quest_included$SD3_PS_SUM, list(pimb19_quest_included$group), sd)
test_sd3_ps = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$SD3_PS_SUM ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_sd3_ps

```

## Manipulation checks

### 1: NASA ratings (Fig. S1)

```{r}

# load data

effort_file <- paste(datadir,"PlaceboProsocialEffort_efforttask.xlsx", sep = "")
pimb19_eff_data_exself <- read.xlsx(effort_file, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE, sheet = 1)

# subset NASA data

pimb19_nasa_eff = subset(pimb19_eff_data_exself, select=c("id", 
                         "group", 
                         "nasa_effort_levels",
                         "nasa_1_effort",
                         "nasa_2_effort",
                         "nasa_3_effort"))

pimb19_nasa_physdem = subset(pimb19_eff_data_exself, select=c("id", 
                         "group", 
                         "nasa_effort_levels",
                         "nasa_1_physdem",
                         "nasa_2_physdem",
                         "nasa_3_physdem"))

pimb19_nasa_unpl = subset(pimb19_eff_data_exself, select=c("id", 
                         "group", 
                         "nasa_effort_levels",
                         "nasa_1_unpl",
                         "nasa_2_unpl",
                         "nasa_3_unpl"))

pimb19_nasa_eff = pimb19_nasa_eff[complete.cases(pimb19_nasa_eff), ] # remove irrelevant rows
pimb19_nasa_physdem = pimb19_nasa_physdem[complete.cases(pimb19_nasa_physdem), ]
pimb19_nasa_unpl = pimb19_nasa_unpl[complete.cases(pimb19_nasa_unpl), ] 

# statistical analysis of effort ratings

pimb19_nasa_eff2 = gather(pimb19_nasa_eff,`nasa_1_effort`,`nasa_2_effort`,`nasa_3_effort`, key = "time", value = "nasa_effort")

pimb19_nasa_eff2$nasa_effort_levels2 = pimb19_nasa_eff2$nasa_effort_levels - 1 # recode effort levels

pimb19_nasa_eff2$nasa_effort_levels <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_eff2$nasa_effort_levels)
pimb19_nasa_eff2$time <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_eff2$time)
pimb19_nasa_eff2$id <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_eff2$id)
pimb19_nasa_eff2$group <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_eff2$group)

# effort <-  ezANOVA(data = pimb19_nasa_eff2, dv = .(nasa_effort), wid = .(id), within = .(nasa_effort_levels, time), between = .(group), type = 2, detailed = TRUE, return_aov = TRUE) # initially run
effort <-  ezANOVA(data = pimb19_nasa_eff2, dv = .(nasa_effort), wid = .(id), within = .(nasa_effort_levels, time), between = .(group), type = 3, detailed = TRUE, return_aov = TRUE) # suggested during revisions
print(effort)

# effort level x time
png(file="insert/data/directory/here/ANOVA_NASA_efforttime.png", width=230, height=120, units='mm', res = 300)
pirateplot(formula = nasa_effort ~ nasa_effort_levels2 + time,
           data = pimb19_nasa_eff2,
           main = "Effort",
           theme = 0,
           ylab = "Proportion of prosocial choices (M +/- SEM)",
           point.pch = 16,
           point.cex = 1.5, 
           jitter.val = .1,  # jitter
           point.o = .5,    # point opacity
           bar.f.o = 0.3,
           avg.line.o = 1,
           inf.method = "se", # ci for confidence interval
           inf.f.o = 0.2,
           inf.b.o = 1,
           gl.col = "white") # font size of axis
dev.off()

# main effect of effort level
pimb19_nasa_eff2 %$% 
  aov(nasa_effort ~ as.factor(nasa_effort_levels)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~nasa_effort_levels) %>% 
  pairs

# main effect of time
pimb19_nasa_eff2 %$% 
  aov(nasa_effort ~ as.factor(time)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~time) %>% 
  pairs

# time x effort level
pimb19_nasa_eff2 %$% 
  aov(nasa_effort ~ as.factor(nasa_effort_levels) * as.factor(time) ) %>% 
  lsmeans(~nasa_effort_levels * time) %>% 
  pairs

# time x group
pimb19_nasa_eff2 %$% 
  aov(nasa_effort ~ as.factor(time) * as.factor(group) ) %>% 
  lsmeans(~time * group) %>% 
  pairs

# statistical analysis of physical demand ratings

pimb19_nasa_physdem2 = gather(pimb19_nasa_physdem,`nasa_1_physdem`,`nasa_2_physdem`,`nasa_3_physdem`, key = "time", value = "nasa_physdem")

pimb19_nasa_physdem2$nasa_effort_levels2 = pimb19_nasa_physdem2$nasa_effort_levels - 1 # recode effort levels

pimb19_nasa_physdem2$nasa_effort_levels <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_physdem2$nasa_effort_levels)
pimb19_nasa_physdem2$time <- as.factor(pimb19_nasa_physdem2$time)

# physdem <-  ezANOVA(data = pimb19_nasa_physdem2, dv = .(nasa_physdem), wid = .(id), within = .(nasa_effort_levels, time), between = .(group), type = 2, detailed = TRUE) # initially run
physdem <-  ezANOVA(data = pimb19_nasa_physdem2, dv = .(nasa_physdem), wid = .(id), within = .(nasa_effort_levels, time), between = .(group), type = 3, detailed = TRUE) # suggested during revisions
print(physdem)

# main effect of effort level
pimb19_nasa_physdem2 %$% 
  aov(nasa_physdem ~ as.factor(nasa_effort_levels)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~nasa_effort_levels) %>% 
  pairs

# main effect of time
pimb19_nasa_physdem2 %$%

  pairs

# effort level x time
png(file="insert/data/directory/here/ANOVA_NASA_physdemtime.png", width=230, height=120, units='mm', res = 300)
pirateplot(formula = nasa_physdem ~ nasa_effort_levels2 + time,
           data = pimb19_nasa_physdem2,

           theme = 0,
           ylab = "Proportion of prosocial choices (M +/- SEM)",

           point.cex = 1.5,

           point.o = .5,    # point opacity
           bar.f.o = 0.3,

           inf.f.o = 0.2,

dev.off()

# statistical analysis of unpleasantness ratings

pimb19_nasa_unpl2 = gather(pimb19_nasa_unpl,`nasa_1_unpl`,`nasa_2_unpl`,`nasa_3_unpl`, key = "time", value = "nasa_unpl")

pimb19_nasa_unpl2$nasa_effort_levels2 = pimb19_nasa_unpl2$nasa_effort_levels - 1 # recode effort levels

print(unpl)

# plot NASA levels together in one plot

# effort

pimb19_nasa_eff2 = gather(pimb19_nasa_eff, 'nasa_1_effort','nasa_2_effort','nasa_3_effort', key = 'time', value = 'effort')

pimb19_nasa_eff3 = pimb19_nasa_eff2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group, time, nasa_effort_levels) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(meanEffort=mean(effort),
                   sdEffort=sd(effort))

# rename levels of factors so they are nicer for the plot
for (row in 1:nrow(pimb19_nasa_eff3)) {
  if (pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"time"] == "nasa_1_effort") { 
    pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"Time"] <- "1. pre-induction"
  } else if (pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"time"] == "nasa_2_effort") {
    pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"Time"] <- "2. post-induction"
  } else if (pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"time"] == "nasa_3_effort") {
    pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"Time"] <- "3. post-session"
  }
}

for (row in 1:nrow(pimb19_nasa_eff3)) {
  if (pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"group"] == "pla") { 
    pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"Group"] <- "placebo"
  } else if (pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"group"] == "con") {
    pimb19_nasa_eff3 [row,"Group"] <- "control"
  }
}

png(file="insert/data/directory/here/NASA_effort.png", width=200, height=150, units='mm', res = 300)
a = ggplot(data=pimb19_nasa_eff3, aes(x=nasa_effort_levels, y=meanEffort, color = Group, linetype = Time), linetype = c("solid", "longdash","dotted")) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("blue","darkorange2")) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  labs(x = "Effort level", y = "Mean effort") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  xlim(1,6) + ylim(0, 17)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
test_anon = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$anonymity ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_anon

test_secdec = t.test(pimb19_quest_included$secret_decisions ~ pimb19_quest_included$group)
test_secdec
```

### 3: Belief in medication effectiveness (Fig. S1)

```{r}

# subset data to take only placebo group

pimb19_quest_pla <- subset(pimb19_quest_included,group == 'pla') 

# average belief rating in total

pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_ave = (pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_precond + pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_postcond + pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_postsess) / 3
mean(pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_ave)
sem(pimb19_quest_pla$medeff_ave)

# group differences 

test_eff = t.test(pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_postcond`,pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_precond`, paired = TRUE)
test_eff2 = t.test(pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_postsess`,pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_precond`, paired = TRUE)
test_eff3 = t.test(pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_postsess`,pimb19_quest_pla$`medeff_postcond`, paired = TRUE)

# recode and plot that data

vars = c("id", "medeff_precond", "medeff_postcond", "medeff_postsess")
data_effectiveness <- pimb19_quest_pla[vars]
data_effectiveness2 <- gather(data_effectiveness, key = 'time',value = 'rating', "medeff_precond", "medeff_postcond", "medeff_postsess", factor_key = TRUE)

for (row in 1:nrow(data_effectiveness2)) {
  if (data_effectiveness2 [row,"time"] == "medeff_precond") { 
    data_effectiveness2 [row,"time2"] <- "Pre-conditioning"
  } else if (data_effectiveness2 [row,"time"] == "medeff_postcond") {
    data_effectiveness2 [row,"time2"] <- "Post-conditioning"
  } else if (data_effectiveness2 [row,"time"] == "medeff_postsess") {
    data_effectiveness2 [row,"time2"] <- "Post-session"
  }
}

png(file="insert/data/directory/here/med_effectiveness.png", width=200, height=200, units='mm', res = 300) 
plot = pirateplot(formula = rating ~ time,
           data = data_effectiveness2,
           main = "Belief in medication effectiveness over the testing session",
           theme = 4,
           point.col = c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           bar.f.col  = c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           bar.b.col  = c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           avg.line.col= c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           inf.f.col= c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           inf.b.col = c("medeff_precond" = "cornflowerblue", "medeff_postcond" = "mediumblue", "medeff_postsess" = "navyblue"),
           gl.col = "white",
           ylab = "Medication effectiveness",
           ylim = c(0,120),
           xlab = "Time",
           point.pch = 16,
```

## Prosocial effort task

### Load data

```{r}

# load data

effort_file <- paste(datadir,"PlaceboProsocialEffort_efforttask.xlsx", sep = "")
pimb19_eff_data <- read.xlsx(effort_file, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE, sheet = 1)

```

### Choices (Fig. 7)

```{r}

# NOTE: All analyses below use the factor shocks (= shocks that the other person received (1-5), whereby lower values mean more helping). For easier understanding, this was reformulated to shock reduction (5-1) in the paper, with lower values now meaning less helping. This in no way changed the results, merely the way they are framed.

pimb19_eff_task = subset(pimb19_eff_data, select=c("id", 
                         "group", 
                         "MVC_task",
                         "trialno",
                         "target_reach",
                         "effort_req",
                         "force_req", 
                         "force_reach",
                         "force_max",
                         "aucForce",
                         "choicemade",
                         "effortoffered",
                         "effortchosen",
                         "shockschosen",
                         "shocksoffered",
                         "key",
                         "RT",
                         "choice1",
                         "choice2"))

# exclude data where no choice made = no key was pressed or person failed to squeeze

d = subset(pimb19_eff_task, choice1 == "variable" | choice1 == "baseline")

# calculate average proportion of work/prosocial choices for each subject, separated by effort and shock reduction level

d_sum_lvls = d %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, group, effortoffered, shocksoffered) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(meanChoice=mean(choice2))

# ANOVA with effort and shocks as factor

d_sum_lvls$effortoffered <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$effortoffered) 
d_sum_lvls$shocksoffered <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$shocksoffered) 
d_sum_lvls$group <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$group)
d_sum_lvls$id <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$id)

# effort_shock_model <- ezANOVA(data = d_sum_lvls, dv = .(meanChoice), wid = .(id), within = .(effortoffered, shocksoffered), between = .(group), type = 2, return_aov = TRUE) # initially run
effort_shock_model <- ezANOVA(data = d_sum_lvls, dv = .(meanChoice), wid = .(id), within = .(effortoffered, shocksoffered), between = .(group), type = 3, return_aov = TRUE) # suggested during revisions
print(effort_shock_model)

# main effect of effort

d_sum_lvls %$% 
  aov(meanChoice ~ as.factor(effortoffered)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~effortoffered) %>% 
  pairs

# main effect of shock

d_sum_lvls %$% 
  aov(meanChoice ~ as.factor(shocksoffered)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~shocksoffered) %>% 
  pairs

# interaction group*shocks

d_sum_lvls %$% 
  aov(meanChoice ~ as.factor(shocksoffered) * as.factor(group)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~shocksoffered * group) %>% 
  pairs

png(file="insert/data/directory/here/ANOVA_choices_groupshocks.png", width=150, height=120, units='mm', res = 300)
pirateplot(formula = meanChoice ~ group + shocksoffered,
           data = d_sum_lvls,
           main = "",theme = 4,
           point.col = c("control" = "blue", "placebo" = "darkorange2"),
           bar.f.col  = c("control" = "blue", "placebo" = "darkorange2"),
           avg.line.col= c("control" = "blue", "placebo" = "darkorange2"),
           inf.f.col= c("control" = "blue", "placebo" = "darkorange2"),
           inf.b.col = c("control" = "blue", "placebo" = "darkorange2"),
           gl.col = "white",
           ylab = "Proportion of prosocial choices (M +/- SEM)",point.pch = 16,point.cex = 1.5,jitter.val = .1,point.o = .5,bar.f.o = 0.5,avg.line.o = 1,inf.method = "se",inf.f.o = 1,inf.b.o = 0.5)
dev.off()

# interaction effort*shocks

d_sum_lvls %$% 
  aov(meanChoice ~ as.factor(shocksoffered) * as.factor(effortoffered)) %>% 
  lsmeans(~shocksoffered * effortoffered) %>% 
  pairs

png(file="insert/data/directory/here/ANOVA_choices_effortshocks.png", width=150, height=120, units='mm', res = 300)
pirateplot(formula = meanChoice ~ effortoffered + shocksoffered,
           data = d_sum_lvls,
           main = "",
           theme = 0,
           ylab = "Proportion of prosocial choices (M +/- SEM)",
           point.pch = 16,
           point.cex = 0.8, 
           jitter.val = .1,  # jitter
           point.o = .5,    # point opacity
           bar.f.o = .5,
           avg.line.o = 1,
           inf.method = "se", # ci for confidence interval
           inf.f.o = 1,
           inf.b.o = 0.5,
           gl.col = "white") # font size of axis
dev.off()

# Linear mixed model using glmer as per Lockwood et al. (2021 Psych Science)

d$id = as.factor(d$id)  
d$group = as.factor(d$group) 
d$shocksoffered = as.factor(d$shocksoffered) 
d$effortoffered = as.factor(d$effortoffered) 

choice_lmm <- glmer(choice2 ~ group*effortoffered*shocksoffered + (1 | id), 
                          data = d,
                          family = binomial,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                          verbose = TRUE)

# Anova(choice_lmm, type = 2) # initially run
Anova(choice_lmm, type = 3) # suggested during revisions

# rerun LMM with trial number as a factor to check for habituation effects (suggested during revisions)

d$tn = as.numeric(d$trialno) - mean(as.numeric(d$trialno))

choice_lmm <- glmer(choice2 ~ group*effortoffered*shocksoffered + tn + (1 | id), 
                          data = d,
                          family = binomial,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                          verbose = TRUE)

Anova(choice_lmm, type = 3)

```

### Reaction times

```{r}

pimb19_RT4 = subset(pimb19_eff_task, select=c("id","group","trialno","RT","choice1", "choice2", "effortoffered", "shocksoffered"))

# ANOVA with effort and shocks as numeric

d_sum_lvls = d %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, group, trialno, effortoffered, shocksoffered) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(RT=mean(RT))

d_sum_lvls$effortoffered <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$effortoffered) 
d_sum_lvls$shocksoffered <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$shocksoffered) 
d_sum_lvls$group <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$group)
d_sum_lvls$trialno <- as.factor(d_sum_lvls$trialno)

#RT_model <- ezANOVA(data = d_sum_lvls, dv = .(RT), wid = .(id), within = .(effortoffered, shocksoffered), between = .(group), type = 2, return_aov = TRUE) # initially run
RT_model <- ezANOVA(data = d_sum_lvls, dv = .(RT), wid = .(id), within = .(effortoffered, shocksoffered), between = .(group), type = 3, return_aov = TRUE) # suggested during revisions
print(RT_model)

# Linear mixed model using lmer

RT_lmm = lme4::lmer(RT ~ group*effortoffered*shocksoffered + (effortoffered*shocksoffered|id), 
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
  data = pimb19_RT4,
  verbose = TRUE) # print what you're doing while doing it

# Anova(RT_lmm, type = 2) # initially run
Anova(RT_lmm, type = 3) # suggested during revisions

# rerun LMM with trial number as a factor to check for habituation effects (suggested during revisions)

pimb19_RT4$tn = as.numeric(pimb19_RT4$trialno) - mean(as.numeric(pimb19_RT4$trialno))

RT_lmm = lme4::lmer(RT ~ group*effortoffered*shocksoffered + tn + (effortoffered*shocksoffered|id), 
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
  data = pimb19_RT4,
  verbose = TRUE) # print what you're doing while doing it

Anova(RT_lmm, type = 3)
```

### Exerted force

```{r}

# load data

force_file <- paste(datadir,"PlaceboProsocialEffort_force.txt", sep = "")
pimb19_force <- read.table(force_file, header = TRUE)

for (row in 1:nrow(pimb19_force)) {
  if (pimb19_force [row,"group"] == 0) { 
    pimb19_force [row,"group"] <- "placebo"
  } else {
    pimb19_force [row,"group"] <- "control"
  }
}

pimb19_force$group <- as.factor(pimb19_force$group) 

# exclude self and fail trials and baseline from data set, so only correct squeeze trials are left
pimb19_force2 = subset(pimb19_force, trialno < 76) # self motivation trial
pimb19_force3 = subset(pimb19_force2, shocks != 10) # fail trials where shocks for other were 10
pimb19_force4 = subset(pimb19_force3, aucForce != -999) # fail trials where no force was exerted
pimb19_force5 = subset(pimb19_force4, effortchosen != -1) # fail trials where no effort was chosen
pimb19_force6 = subset(pimb19_force5, effortchosen != 0)

# Linear mixed model with lmer

pimb19_force6$id = as.factor(pimb19_force6$id)  
pimb19_force6$shocks = as.factor(pimb19_force6$shocks) 
pimb19_force6$effort = as.factor(pimb19_force6$effort) 
pimb19_force6$group = as.factor(pimb19_force6$group) 

force_lmm <- lme4::lmer(aucForce ~ group*effort*shocks + (1 | id), 
                        data = pimb19_force6, 
                        verbose = TRUE) 

# Anova(force_lmm, type = 2) # initially run
Anova(force_lmm, type = 3) # suggested during revisions

# rerun LMM with trial number as a factor to check for habituation effects (suggested during revisions)

pimb19_force6$tn = as.numeric(pimb19_force6$trialno) - mean(as.numeric(pimb19_force6$trialno))

force_lmm <- lme4::lmer(aucForce ~ group*effort*shocks + tn + (1 | id), 
                        data = pimb19_force6, 
                        verbose = TRUE) 

Anova(force_lmm, type = 3)
```

## Mediation analysis (suggested during revisions)

```{r}

# Tutorial used: https://towardsdatascience.com/doing-and-reporting-your-first-mediation-analysis-in-r-2fe423b92171

# IV = corrected pain / placebo response (7 - first-hand pain rating in the pain trials)
# DV = proportion of prosocial choices
# mediator = other-related unpleasantness (pain trials)

# set a seed to get the same results
set.seed(1)

# this makes it an index for the strength of the placebo effect
self_pain$correctedpain = 7 - self_pain$pain

# gather dataset for mediation
mediation = cbind(self_pain, other_pain, other_unpl, d_sum)

# rename columns to distinguish them from each other
colnames(mediation)[4] <- "nopainself"
colnames(mediation)[5] <- "painself"
colnames(mediation)[6] <- "indexself"

colnames(mediation)[11] <- "nopainotherp"
colnames(mediation)[12] <- "painotherp"
colnames(mediation)[13] <- "indexotherp"

colnames(mediation)[17] <- "nopainotheru"
colnames(mediation)[18] <- "painotheru"
colnames(mediation)[19] <- "indexotheru"

# standardize predictors
mediation$correctedpain_z = scale(mediation$correctedpain, c=T,s=T)
mediation$painotheru_z = scale(mediation$painotheru, c=T,s=T)

mediation$correctedpain_z = as.numeric(mediation$correctedpain_z)
mediation$painotheru_z = as.numeric(mediation$painotheru_z)

# step 1: check for the total effect of IV on DV
fit.totaleffect=lm(meanChoice~correctedpain_z,mediation)
summary(fit.totaleffect)

# step 2: check for effect of IV on mediator
fit.mediator=lm(painotheru_z~correctedpain_z,mediation)
summary(fit.mediator)

# step 3: check everything together
fit.dv=lm(meanChoice~correctedpain_z+painotheru_z,mediation)
summary(fit.dv)

# step 4: causal analysis (you need mediation package)
results = mediate(fit.mediator, fit.dv, treat='correctedpain_z', mediator='painotheru_z', boot=T)
summary(results)

```
